expected_outcome.description: Block the change: the check on line 11 of `src/routes/attachments.ts` compares `target` with `userDir` without a trailing path separator, so a user can read another user's files when that user's id starts with the same digits (user 12 asking for `../123/invoice.pdf` gets `/srv/app/uploads/123/invoice.pdf`, which passes the check). A blocking finding must identify this prefix bypass of the `startsWith` check and fix it, for example by comparing against `userDir + sep` or by rejecting a `relative(userDir, target)` that starts with `..`.
